```diff
@@ -3,3 +3,4 @@ Usage
 Call `slugify(title)` to build a URL slug.
 
 Slugs are lower case.
+Repeated separators collapse to one dash.
```

### src/text/slug.py
```diff
@@ -1,6 +1,8 @@
 import re
 
+_SEPARATORS = re.compile(r"[^a-z0-9]+")
+
 
 def slugify(title):
-    return title.lower().replace(" ", "-")
+    return _SEPARATORS.sub("-", title.lower()).strip("-")
```

### src/text/slug.py
```diff
@@ -20,3 +22,7 @@ def is_slug(value):
     if not value:
         return False
     return value == slugify(value)
+
+
+def slug_length(title):
+    return len(slugify(title))
```

### tests/test_slug.py
```diff
@@ -5,3 +5,7 @@ from text.slug import slugify
 
 def test_lower_case():
     assert slugify("Hello World") == "hello-world"
+
+
+def test_collapses_separators():
+    assert slugify("a  --  b") == "a-b"
```
